hint.NOT_ENOUGH: Some material is covered by nothing yet: buy it, or release with the planner’s reason.
hint.DELAYED: Some material comes late: a purchase order is past its date or arrives after the need.
hint.REQUESTED: Some material is only in a draft purchase order or a firm planned order: send the order.
hint.EXPECTED: Material short today arrives in time with a sent purchase order.
hint.NOT_BOOKED: The stock is there but not reserved for this work order: reserve it.
hint.RECEIVED: Every material is issued to it or reserved for it.
hint.NOT_PLANNED: The plan has no material need for it (its order is not planned, or it is a repair): the checks above decide.

holds.title: Holds
holds.none: No hold names this work order.
holds.noRight: Holds are shown to people with the quality holds role.
holds.banner: On hold: {reason}. It goes back to “{back}” when the hold is released.
holds.floorRefuses: Floor tablets refuse its work and show the reason; nothing is issued to it.
holds.underRecord: The hold comes from another record (a nonconformance): that record lifts it.
holds.hint: Quality releases a hold (with a fresh authenticator code); the person who placed it cannot release it.

hold.title: Put {number} on hold
hold.body: A hold stops the work: the release, issuing, cutting, bundles and scans wait until quality releases it.
hold.noteHint: What happened, for the people who follow the hold.
hold.floor: Floor tablets refuse to start it and show the reason.
hold.releaseBy: Releasing the hold needs the quality role and a fresh authenticator code.

held.reasons: The hold reasons are still being read.
held.note: This reason needs a note of at least 3 characters.
held.noteLong: The note is longer than 500 characters.

releaseHold.title: Release the hold
releaseHold.body: The work goes back to where it was held. Each condition below must hold first.
releaseHold.statement: I made none of the held garments.
releaseHold.noteHint: Why it may go on (kept with the hold).
releaseHold.stepUp: Releasing asks for a fresh authenticator code.
releaseHold.stepUpSentence: Releasing a hold lets the work go on: confirm it is you.

ACTIVE.open: The hold is no longer active.

NOT_PLACER.ok: You did not place this hold.
NOT_PLACER.open: You placed this hold: someone else releases it.

NOT_MAKER.ok: You made none of the held garments.
NOT_MAKER.open: You worked on the held garments: someone else releases it.

STATEMENT.ok: You signed that you made none of the held garments.
STATEMENT.open: The floor records name the station only: sign that you made none of the held garments.

CR_VI.ok: The lot’s chromium VI result passed.
CR_VI.open: The lot waits for a passed chromium VI result.

REINSPECTION.ok: An inspection passed after the hold.
REINSPECTION.open: An inspection must pass after the hold.

problem.wrong: That code is wrong or was used already.
problem.locked: Too many tries: wait a minute and try again.
problem.unavailable: The code could not be checked: try again.

finished.title: Finished to stock
finished.noReports: Nothing reported to finished goods yet.
finished.hint: Only garments quality released go into stock, per size, under the batch number.
finished.hintSerial: Only garments quality released go into stock, per size; each keeps its serial.

finish.title: Report {number} finished to stock
finish.body: The released garments of each size go into a finished-goods place of the site. A report can be taken back later.
finish.noPlace: The site has no finished-goods place

held.over: A size asks for more than can go now.
held.none: Ask for at least one garment.

yield.title: Yield

planned.STYLE: Plan: the style revision’s hide yield
planned.BOM: Plan: what the BOM’s wastage expects

yield.unmatched: {area} cut as single parts is left out (its pattern is not known).
yield.noCutter: Per hide and lot only: never per cutter.

scrap.title: Scrap, rework and holds
scrap.noRight: Scrap and rework are shown to people with the production scrap role.
scrap.none: No scrap and no rework on this work order.
scrap.hint: Counted from the floor’s scans and the rework orders; per operation, never per person.

flow.title: Operation flow
flow.hint: The pile waiting before each operation.

reserve.title: Reserve leather: {material}
reserve.body: Tick the hides to set aside for this work order, whole ({needed} still to issue). A hide another order holds, or one not released, cannot be ticked.

empty.title: No hide of this leather at the site
empty.body: Receive leather, or move some from another site.

reserve.hint: A reserve holds the stock for this work order: the floor issues it by scan.

split.title: Split bundle {code}
split.body: Bundle {code} ({cell}) holds {quantity} garments. The ones split off go into a child bundle with its own ticket; its history stays with both.

reasons.REWORKHint: They go back to an earlier operation.

split.ticket: The child bundle’s ticket prints on the site’s label printer.

pick.title: Pick list {number}
pick.heading: Pick list
pick.foot: Issue by scan on the floor; the list shows usable stock only.

cutting.title: Cutting list {number}
cutting.heading: Cutting list
cutting.foot: Garments per colourway and size, with the parts to cut.

held.busy: Wait for the change in progress.
held.noHoldPlace: Placing holds needs the quality holds role.
held.noHoldRelease: Releasing holds needs the quality role.
held.holdNotActive: The hold is no longer active.
held.notPlacer: You placed this hold: someone else releases it.
held.underRecord: Its hold comes from another record: that record lifts it.
held.noFinish: Reporting to stock needs the production finish role.
held.repairNoStock: A repair’s garment goes back to its customer, never into stock.
held.noFinishedPlace: The site has no finished-goods place.
held.nothingReleased: No garment is released by quality yet.
held.allInStock: Every released garment is in stock already.
held.noReserve: Reserving needs the stock reserve role.
held.bundleOne: A bundle of one garment cannot be split.

notice.held: Put on hold: the floor refuses its work until quality releases it.
notice.holdReleased: Hold released: the work goes on.
notice.reserved_one: {count} hide reserved for this work order.
notice.reserved_other: {count} hides reserved for this work order.
notice.split_one: {count} garment split off into a new bundle.
notice.split_other: {count} garments split off into a new bundle.

problem.conflict: Someone changed it meanwhile, or it is not possible in its state now: the page reads it again.
problem.forbidden: You may not do this here.
problem.invalid: Something asked is not accepted: check the values.
problem.offline: The factory server cannot be reached: try again.
problem.write: It could not be saved: try again.
problem.read: It could not be read: try again.
